name: COOKiES eTracker Analytics
description: Submodule of COOKiES to manage eTracker Analytics (by "etracker" module) inside of COOKiES consent management.
project_description: cookies_etracker is a submodule shipped with the etracker project that integrates the etracker tracker with the COOKiES consent-management module so tracking respects the visitor's cookie consent. It registers an etracker cookie service (cookies.cookies_service.etracker) in COOKiES, and via hook_library_info_alter() and hook_page_attachments() it applies one of four 'knockout modes' (config cookies_etracker.settings:knockout_mode) selectable on the etracker settings form (a form_alter adds a 'Blocking mode' radio set): 'Most accuracy' (block_cookies_true_without_consent) tracks cookie-less before consent and enables cookies after; 'Most privacy' (knockout_without_consent_block_cookies_true) knocks the tracking script out entirely until consent then tracks cookie-less; 'Mixed' (knockout_without_consent_block_cookies_false) knocks out until consent then tracks with cookies; 'Ignore consent' (block_cookies_true) leaves etracker's own behaviour unchanged. Knockout is done by rewriting the etracker script tag's type to application/json (preventing execution) and healing it in JavaScript on the COOKiES consent event; the block_cookies mode instead toggles the loader's data-block-cookies attribute and calls _etracker.enableCookies()/disableCookies(). hook_install() enables etracker's 'Disable cookies' setting so cookies are blocked until configuration is finalized. Requires the cookies and etracker modules.
